name: Thunderhead
desc: A convective storm cell towering over a dark plain — cauliflower turrets boil upward out of the base, pile into a sheared anvil that streams downwind, hang mammatus lobes from its underside and drag a rain shaft to the horizon, the whole cell lit from within by a slow diffused sheet-glow that never flashes.

energy.doc: convective vigour — tower height, updraft rate, turret count, rim light

shear.doc: wind shear — how far the anvil streams downwind

glow.doc: diffused internal sheet-glow — slow swell, never a flash

y.doc: cloud-base height; the horizon sits just below it
